subject: general
question: Which of these is a part of solid waste management infrastructure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Garbage collection and disposal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Garbage collection and disposal** is a critical component of **solid waste management infrastructure**.
 
• It involves the collection, segregation, transportation, treatment, and disposal of **solid waste** generated in households, industries, and commercial establishments.
 
• This process helps in maintaining **cleanliness, public health, and environmental sustainability**.
 
• Garbage collection systems usually involve the use of **vehicles, bins, and containers** to collect waste from designated areas.
 
• Proper disposal methods include **landfilling, incineration, recycling, composting, and waste-to-energy conversion**.
 
• Effective garbage disposal helps reduce the risk of **diseases** caused by improper waste management.
 
• It also contributes to **resource conservation** by promoting recycling and reuse of waste materials.
 
• Many countries are adopting advanced technologies such as **mechanized waste collection systems, smart bins, and waste segregation systems**.
 
• Government initiatives such as **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** in India focus on improving the efficiency of garbage collection and disposal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Drainage tanks**__

 __
 
• **Drainage tanks** are used for managing liquid waste, primarily sewage or stormwater, rather than solid waste.
 
• They are part of **sewage management infrastructure**, which ensures proper disposal of wastewater and prevents waterlogging or contamination.
 
 
 
• **Sewage pipelines**__
 __
 
• **Sewage pipelines** are designed to transport liquid waste, including human excreta and wastewater, to treatment plants or disposal areas.
 
• These pipelines are integral to **urban sanitation systems** but are not involved in managing solid waste.
 
 
 
• **Electricity transmission lines**__
 
 
• **Electricity transmission lines** are used to transport electrical energy from power generation plants to distribution networks.
 
• They play a vital role in energy infrastructure but have no direct connection to solid waste management.
